summary: Forward heap construction processes parents before their child subtrees are valid heaps, causing kmerge to yield unsorted output. The fix processes internal nodes bottom-up. The added test kmerge_2 in tests/tests.rs merges sorted iterators with initial heads 3, 2, 1, 0; the buggy implementation yields 1 first instead of 0.
expected_failure: Failed assertion Some(1) == Some(0) for iteration 0
